Here is a relaxed 3 day Jaipur plan for your parents, with one main sight each morning and a slow evening.

Day 1, the Pink City: Amber Fort early, before the crowds and heat, with a jeep ride up to skip the steep walk. Stop for photos at Jal Mahal on the way back. In the evening, see Hawa Mahal and stroll Johari Bazaar for jewellery and block prints.
Day 2, royal Jaipur: City Palace and Jantar Mantar in the morning, then a long lunch and a rest at the hotel. Visit Albert Hall Museum at dusk, when it is lit up.
Day 3, easy and spiritual: Govind Dev Ji Temple in the morning, then Birla Mandir and Patrika Gate for photos. Spend the afternoon on shopping for Bagru prints and juttis, and finish with a Rajasthani thali dinner.

Late October to February is the best time to go, as the days are pleasant. A hired car with a driver for all three days will save their knees. When are they travelling, and from which city?
